name: lock-twin
note: One controller seen twice in the PS2 layout, as a PlayStation controller is beside the Xbox controller DS4Windows or DualSenseX makes of it (the SDK's virtual controller and its twin, XBE_VIRTUAL_PAD=2: presses are a controller's, black R1, white L1, lt L2, rt R2). Locked on among the two knights of room 5.12, R1 guards and L1 resets the camera without touching the lock-on; L2 changes it, R2 lets it go (lock, the actor locked on). The game takes all four ports' buttons together and only the first port's were swapped: through 1.10.1 R1 also turned the lock-on off and L1 changed it (Reddit).
